dataset_governance.primary_citation: Wang X, Peng Y, Lu L, Lu Z, Bagheri M, Summers RM. ChestX-ray8: Hospital-scale Chest X-ray Database and Benchmarks on Weakly-Supervised Classification and Localization of Common Thorax Diseases. IEEE CVPR 2017 (arXiv:1705.02315).
scientific_limitations: NIH ChestX-ray14 labels are NLP-extracted binary {0, 1} tags from clinical radiology reports and contain documented NLP extraction noise; they are NOT radiologist consensus ground truth.
NIH ChestX-ray14 ontology is NOT equivalent to Stanford CheXpert; CheXpert -1 uncertainty policies are strictly excluded.

Upstream TorchXRayVision trained 'densenet121-res224-nih' on its internal patient-grouped split (seed=0) of NIH ChestX-ray14, which may partially overlap NIH's official test_list.txt. For zero-overlap out-of-domain evaluation on the 7 shared classes, run --checkpoint-profile chex_external.

model_metadata.training_overlap_disclosure: Upstream TorchXRayVision trained 'densenet121-res224-nih' on its internal patient-grouped split (seed=0) of NIH ChestX-ray14, which may partially overlap NIH's official test_list.txt. For zero-overlap out-of-domain evaluation on the 7 shared classes, run --checkpoint-profile chex_external.
model_metadata.label_governance_note: NIH ChestX-ray14 labels are NLP-mined binary {0, 1} labels from radiological reports (Wang et al., CVPR 2017) and are NOT equivalent to CheXpert labels or radiologist consensus ground truth.

target_label_definitions.no_finding_rule: All 14 disease columns == 0 (not a 15th disease class)

metric_definitions.auroc: Area Under the ROC Curve (sklearn.metrics.roc_auc_score).
metric_definitions.auprc: Average Precision (AP) computed via step-wise rectangular precision-recall integration: AP = sum_n (R_n - R_{n-1}) * P_n (sklearn.metrics.average_precision_score; no linear/trapezoidal interpolation).
metric_definitions.f1: Binary F1-score on test split using frozen validation_optimal_threshold.
metric_definitions.sensitivity: TP / (TP + FN) on test split using frozen validation_optimal_threshold.
metric_definitions.specificity: TN / (TN + FP) on test split using frozen validation_optimal_threshold.
metric_definitions.brier_score: Mean squared probability error mean((p - y)^2).
metric_definitions.ece: 10-bin Expected Calibration Error on [0, 1].
metric_definitions.confidence_intervals: 95% percentile CIs from valid dual-class patient_id-clustered bootstrap resamples.

metric_definitions.auroc: Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (sklearn.metrics.roc_auc_score); undefined (None) if < 2 classes.

metric_definitions.f1: Binary F1-score evaluated on test split using frozen validation_optimal_threshold (sklearn.metrics.f1_score, zero_division=0).
metric_definitions.sensitivity: True Positive Rate TP / (TP + FN) evaluated on test split using frozen validation_optimal_threshold.
metric_definitions.specificity: True Negative Rate TN / (TN + FP) evaluated on test split using frozen validation_optimal_threshold.
metric_definitions.brier_score: Mean squared error between predicted probability and binary label: mean((p - y)^2).
metric_definitions.ece: Expected Calibration Error across 10 equal-width bins in [0, 1].
